'''Haugg Nerf Industries''', founded by the criminal [[Groff Haugg]], was one of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscants]] largest [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]]-meat processing companies during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The corporation served as a front for many of Groff's criminal activities, including the production of brainwashing [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]]. These death sticks were shipped to various regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] inside the nerf-meat containers. The plant was located in Coruscant's [[Industrial District/Legends|industrial district]].
